title: Ruth & Cary Portrait Outside, 1954 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A clear, well-focused black and white vintage snapshot showing a woman named Ruth crouching in a sunny yard while holding a young boy named Cary on her knee. They are posed in front of a small spruce tree near the front porch of a suburban home. The child wears a short-sleeved patterned button-up shirt, shorts, folded striped socks, and high-top shoes, reflecting 1950s children's fashion. Handwritten notes on the back date the photo to June 13, 1954.
